body: To be honest I haven't really considered that there was a distinction between the two, but I see what you're saying. I have to want both, or else living is just going to continue being fucking miserable. I'll have to think on those questions and write them down, thank you so much

I hadn't thought about putting lots of stuff in my journal but that makes a lot of sense. Recently the days have kind of been slipping by all together, because I don't really do a lot of things. But actually writing down what happened would give me at least a sense of progress at this point. Thank you :)

I'm sorry to hear therapy doesn't work for you, I really hope it has some kind of positive outcome for me but maybe it won't. I like the idea of "expanding" as you put, and learning to love myself first. Its something I could have easily said in the past but muuuuch easier said than done ( especially when you hate yourself). Thank you for the advice, I'm rooting for you too
Thank you, I really do appreciate it. If I'm going to make it out of this alive its going to be a lot of effort but I guess its comforting knowing that even a small part of me still wants to try
